scope: Bounded Hydragen execution/state transfer audit for C07. Read-only primary-source retrieval and CPU scalar/accounting checks. No model execution, packages, environments, or coordinator state changes.
search_method: Direct retrieval of the previously identified primary paper and pinned official code. No repeated broad discovery search.

title: Hydragen: High-Throughput LLM Inference with Shared Prefixes
head_check: git ls-remote official repository HEAD returned the pinned revision in this segment
training: No trained predictor or logical weight update required by this attention algorithm
model_scope: Llama family. No inspected Ouro adapter.

mechanism: Attention decomposition plus inter-sequence query batching over identical KV. Generalization to hierarchical prefixes.
device_scope: CodeLlama-13B end-to-end TP8 on eight A100-40GB GPUs. Attention microbenchmark on one A100-40GB. H100/L40S microbenchmarks in C.2.
measurement_scope: Decode-only E2E via one-token subtraction. Microbenchmarks use CUDA graphs, 1000 warmup/1000 timing iterations and L2 flush.
limits: Not Ouro, not an original-gate validation, not a distributed branch-ownership comparison.

finding: Queries differ while shared K/V are identical. Row ordering and divisibility encode hierarchical membership. Private suffix attention uses separate K/V. Two-way merge uses Triton, other counts use Torch.

Explicit shared caches coexist with unique-per-completion storage. Projected/RoPE-transformed K/V are stored. Shared levels have an explicit lifecycle. No inspected dynamic speculative branch adapter.
Ordinary head-sharded TP composes with prefix batching. Cache configuration is partitioned before allocation. Each rank has resident local head KV. Output activations use all-reduce.
unjustified_claim_rejected: TP inherently transfers historical KV remotely for every query.

finding: Only Llama-family integration and no full server/continuous batching. LSE is FP32 but partial outputs are FP16/BF16, followed by a FP32 merge. README acknowledges error relative to uninterrupted FP32 accumulation.
quality_scope: README author statement about model quality, not a campaign reproduction or exact-token proof.
code_availability_limit: README says hierarchical coding-experiment reproduction code is not provided.

finding: CUDA0 FP16 attention test. Absolute difference <=2e-3 and mean relative difference <=5e-3. Not bitwise equality. Test not run by this worker.
Sheared-LLaMA-1.3B FP16. token_overrides uses reference generated tokens. Absolute logit difference <0.75 and mean relative difference <0.05. Not a free-running token-equality proof. Test not run.
Official microbenchmark uses BF16 Q/K/V and default 1000 warmup/1000 iterations. No execution in this audit.

read_scope: Selected lines from an rg search, not the complete benchmark implementation.
finding: Do not infer one paper-wide BF16 E2E precision from the BF16 microbenchmark.
Same-role/depth prefix mapping is already shared. Child appends and retained ancestor resources require lifetime control. CPU ownership transfer does not move KV data.
One recurrent call advances lanes carrying depth and branch identity. Prefix optimization need not fragment the shared projections/MLP batch.

locators: 345-397 mixed-depth advance and original gate code
finding: Same-slot queries already group into a causal varlen segment. Distinct depth slots are not identical merely because weights are shared. Terminal copies can establish entrywise aliases only.
limit: This reinspection does not validate campaign original-gate speculative correctness.

eligibility: Immutable same-depth/layer/head-shard prefix with matching lineage/state epoch, position semantics, visibility and score rules. Queries can differ. Private appends remain private.
cross_depth: FixedR4 does not imply equality. Exact terminal-copy provenance may permit limited adaptive aliases. Full-R4 prefill does not imply one common depth cache.
ready_width_limit: One query at each of four depths has no cross-query prefix group reuse. External C and branch count do not determine per-group ready width.
precision_limit: Real-arithmetic decomposition does not prove native BF16 or original-gate parity.

unit: One equal-size immutable prefix block per depth. Ideal reuse and full TP head sharding.

changed_assumption: Mandatory comparison includes TP with generic same-depth shared-prefix attention, not only independently repeated prefix reads.
not_changed: need for tentative ancestor KV delivery
source_count_credit: Not used as a progress criterion.

campaign_elapsed_accounting: Concurrent worker time is not additional campaign elapsed time.
cpu_check_status: PASS: two scalar decomposition cases and four logical grouping cases
